description: This file defines the PHP class ApiGatewayManagementApiClient, which is used to interact with the Amazon API Gateway Management API service. It includes method signatures for deleting connections, getting connection details, and posting to connections, indicating it is part of an SDK client for AWS API Gateway Management API.

classes.name: ApiGatewayManagementApiClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon API Gateway Management API service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: deleteConnection
methods.description: Deletes a WebSocket connection identified by the connection ID.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific WebSocket connection.

methods.name: getConnectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a specific WebSocket connection.

methods.name: postToConnection
methods.description: Posts a message to a specific WebSocket connection.

methods.name: postToConnectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously posts a message to a WebSocket connection.
